observations: Photo 0: Front view of a silver pickup truck with a hexagonal grille, Toyota emblem, and LED headlights. The truck is on a gravel surface, with a red canopy and trees in the background.

Photo 1: Side view of the same truck, showing a black front bumper, black side mirrors, and black wheels. The truck appears to be a 4-door pickup. The windshield has a sticker with 'No Start' and '963' written on it.

Photo 2: Rear view of the truck, showing a black tonneau cover, red taillights, and a black rear bumper. The tailgate has 'TOYOTA' and 'V6' visible. The same 'No Start' and '963' sticker is on the rear window.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'TEEKAYWHEELS'.
The truck appears to be a 4x4 model based on the visible suspension and tires.
The 'V6' badge on the tailgate suggests a 6-cylinder engine, but no engine type or model is visible.

claims.evidence: The year 2024 is not visible in any photo. The 'TRD' badge is visible on the tailgate in photo 2, but no model year is readable. The 'V6' badge confirms a 6-cylinder engine, but not the exact model year.
Photo 2 shows 'V6' on the tailgate, confirming a 6-cylinder engine.
No photo shows the ignition or engine start. The 'No Start' sticker on the windshield may indicate a mechanical issue, but cannot confirm if it is a push-to-start system.
No photo shows the roof or any opening. The windshield sticker does not indicate a moonroof. The truck appears to be a standard hardtop or softtop without visible roof mechanism.
No proof of import clearance or customs documentation is visible. The term 'verified duty' is unclear and cannot be verified from photos.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly. Original receipt and warranty available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine is not a V6 as claimed, or is a different model/year
risks.proof: Photo of the engine bay or engine block with visible model and year.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-V6 or older model, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Vehicle is not a 2024 model as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the VIN plate or dashboard with model year visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an older model, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or is not push-to-start
risks.proof: Video or photo of the engine starting with the key turned or push-to-start button pressed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which reduces value.

risks.proof: Photo of the roof with the sunroof or moonroof mechanism visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard hardtop, which reduces value.

risks.proof: Photo of the import clearance or customs papers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the VIN plate, usually on the inner door jamb or engine compartment.
Photo of the engine bay or engine block to confirm V6 model and year.
Video or photo of the engine starting with the key turned or push-to-start button pressed.
Photo of the roof to confirm moonroof presence.
Photo of the VIN plate or dashboard to confirm model year.
Photo of the import clearance or customs papers.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
